## Summary

**MOVEX** (Move convert source to destination): Endian convert and move.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `Re-ordered source → destination` |
| Syntax | `MOVEX <ea>,b`<br>`MOVEX b,<ea>` |
| Short | Endian convert and move. |
| Description | Changes byte order from the source and places it in the destination. |
| Condition codes | see table |

### Condition codes

| X | N | Z | V | C |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| – | * | * | 0 | 0 |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–8 | `00001110` |
| 1 | 7–6 | Size |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | B |
| 2 | 11 | d |
| 2 | 10–0 | `00000010000` |

- Size 1=word, 2= long
- B=data or address-register.
- direction d=0: &lt;ea&gt;,b else b,&lt;ea&gt;

### Example

```asm
    movex.l    a0,a1
```

```text
a a0: .. .. .. .. 00 11 22 33
Result:
b a1: .. .. .. .. 33 22 11 00
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no MOVEX. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
